notes: Content Designer: every size can have its own layout. The size you design at is the base; the others follow it until you change them. Switch 'Seen at' (or click a size in the row under the card), move, resize, add or remove anything, and…
A card on the desktop draws the defined layout nearest its real size, so a 3 x 1 clock can be one line on a short strip and a stacked hero on a tall one.
